Gene structure track

Source: R/geom-gene-track.R
geom_gene_track.Rd

Draws gene models with exons, UTRs, and introns with strand direction arrows, plus one italic label per gene at its 5' or 3' end. One row per level of the y aesthetic, which defaults to gene_name. Pair with coord_locus() to zoom to a window and theme_genomic(y_axis = "blank") for a clean gene track.

Labels for genes extending past the window are kept at the panel edge.

Usage

geom_gene_track(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  genes_of_interest = NULL,
  exon_fill_color = "darkred",
  gene_name_side = "five_prime",
  gene_label_size = 4,
  gene_label_padding = 1.5,
  exon_height = 7,
  exon_arrowhead_width = 7,
  utr_linewidth = 5,
  intron_linewidth = 0.7,
  inherit.aes = FALSE
)

Arguments

mapping

Set of aesthetic mappings created by ggplot2::aes(). Defaults to y = gene_name. Map fill (e.g. fill = gene_name) to color exons by a column.

data

GRanges object or data frame of gene segments with seqnames, start, end, strand, gene_name, and segment (exon, intron, five_prime_utr, three_prime_utr) columns. Defaults to devgru::gene_body_hg38.

genes_of_interest

Character vector of gene names to draw. Default NULL draws every gene in the window.

exon_fill_color

Exon fill color, used when fill is not mapped.

gene_name_side

Side to place gene labels, "five_prime" or "three_prime". Either a single value or one per gene in genes_of_interest.

gene_label_size

Gene label text size, default: 4

gene_label_padding

Space between gene end and label in mm, default: 1.5

exon_height

Height of exons in mm, default: 7

exon_arrowhead_width

Width of exon arrowheads in mm. Set to 0 for plain rectangular exons, default: 7

utr_linewidth

Line width of UTRs, default: 5

intron_linewidth

Line width of introns, default: 0.7

inherit.aes

See ggplot2::layer().

Value

List of ggplot2 layers

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ggplot2::ggplot() +
  geom_gene_track(genes_of_interest = "BCL6") +
  coord_locus("chr3:187734001-187751500", flank = 5000) +
  theme_genomic(y_axis = "blank")

# All genes in the window, exons colored per gene
ggplot2::ggplot() +
  geom_gene_track(ggplot2::aes(fill = gene_name)) +
  coord_locus("chr3:187600001-187800000") +
  theme_genomic(y_axis = "blank")
} # }
